That change improved the top-ranked positions (rank_depth gains at depths 1–3 and positive changes for longer bins ≤10/≤99) but removed useful early cut choices for short-latency bins (small negative by_bin at ≤5 and ≤7), producing roughly balanced wins and losses and a negligible overall mean change.
